captive_summary: As-designed, Essar Energy Services Ltd's proposed Hazira FSRU (Phase-I 6 MTPA + Phase-II 6 MTPA) had no on-site gas-fired captive power: the only power-generation equipment named in the Prefeasibility Report is a diesel emergency backup genset at shore. Same document (p.14-16): RLNG is piped to 'offtakers such as Essar Steel and Essar Power and other third party customers connected to the grid' -- confirming the supply-out direction, not captive generation.
